name: Watase Haruko
source:
A teacher with a fluffy, calm appearance and a voluptuous body. As soon as she was assigned to the class, she attracted the boys with her boobs. 

She is a popular teacher who teaches the class in a laid-back, gently tone. She is also Nanao-sensei's junior in college.

[Translated from [url=http://www.ole-m.net/products/saimin_wonderful/character_h.html#character_h]official website[/url]]
